# `silk/platform/windows/time_zone`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

The time zone setting of Windows.

## When to use
The `OsLocalZone` provider of `silk.time.zones_native` uses `WindowsTimeZone` on Windows.
Application code requires the `LocalZone` effect of `silk.time.zones` and does not call this
module.

## Details
Windows names its zones with its own names, such as `E. South America Standard Time`, and
ships no IANA zone files. `WindowsTimeZone.keyName` reads the name of the zone that the
machine is set to, and the provider maps it to an IANA name with the table of the Unicode
CLDR project in the time zone bundle of the standard library.
